root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `pdu->alloc_size + pdu->max_hdr_size >= pdu->max_hdr_size + 2` when the parse target is allocated.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `coap_pdu_init()` creates a parse target that may immediately enter the extended-token parser, the heap allocation passed to `coap_malloc_type()` must reserve at least two bytes beyond `pdu->token` for the later `pdu->token[0]` / `pdu->token[1]` probes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original allocates only `pdu->alloc_size + pdu->max_hdr_size`, which is just the header area when `size == 0`, so `pdu->token` starts at the allocation boundary. The fixed original raises the allocation to `max(2, pdu->alloc_size) + pdu->max_hdr_size`, satisfying the missing root obligation for the same protected parsing event.

nodes.state: At the extended-token sink, the parser reads `pdu->token[0]` from the token base itself while the vulnerable allocation end is `pdu->token + pdu->alloc_size`, so the read starts at or past the end of the allocated token/payload region.

edges.relation: The token-base pointer created by `coap_pdu_init()` is carried unchanged to the later extended-token read, so the sink dereferences the same boundary address established at allocation time.
